failure_patterns.pattern: result_persistence_omission: Search or filter calls were emitted without assigning and saving their results.

rejected_edits.content: Assign each `get_results_from_cache` return value to a variable and use that variable for subsequent processing; do not leave cache reads as bare calls.
rejected_edits.target: When the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result and apply only criteria not already represented in its summary.

rejected_edits.content: - On each turn, compare the full conversation with compatible cache summaries. If several results match, retrieve the most specific one whose summary includes the earlier requested criteria; do not fall back to a broader base result. When the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result and apply only criteria not already represented in its summary. Treat correction or replacement cues such as “actually,” “instead,” or “only” as superseding conflicting earlier preferences. A result that reflects a superseded criterion is not compatible: do not filter it as if the criterion were additive; search using the current explicit criteria unless another compatible result is available. Do not filter unrelated results; search when no compatible cached result covers the requested entity or category. Assign each search or transformation result to a variable and save that exact output under the established base key or a distinct descriptive key for a filtered result. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.
rejected_edits.target: - On each turn, consider the full conversation and cached result summaries. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match the request. If the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the matching filter, and save the updated result. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cached results do not cover. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints in filters that were already applied. Save each newly generated search or transformation result under a unique cache key. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.
